definitions.explanation: Describes two or more things happening in an alternating pattern, taking turns one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧{交互|こうご}に⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Raise your legs alternately, left and right.
I planted red and white flowers alternately.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦バイオリン→バイオリン：00009_baiorin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{交互|こうご}に⟦メロディー→メロディー：05877_merodii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奏|かな}でる→奏でる：12176_kanaderu⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧になっている。
examples.english: In this piece, the piano and violin take turns playing the melody.

notes:
USAGE:
The base word ⟦{交互|こうご}→交互：16076_kougo⟧ is a noun/na-adjective meaning 'alternation.' The adverbial form {交互|こうご}に is the most common usage. Describes a regular back-and-forth pattern between two or more elements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交互|こうご}に⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (repeat alternately)
- {交互|こうご}に⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ (arrange alternately)
- {交互|こうご}に⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (do in turns)
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧{交互|こうご}に (alternating left and right)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代|か}わる{代|が}わる: in turn/one after another — emphasizes people taking turns; more colloquial
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in order/in sequence — follows a set order, not necessarily alternating
